description: Full-text search across the House Oversight Committee documents from the Jeffrey Epstein investigation — transcribed interviews, subpoenas and letters the committee published as PDFs. Returns the matching page with a snippet, the document title and the committee URL, so every result can be checked at source. Use it to find what a named witness said under questioning, which institutions were subpoenaed, or where a topic appears in the record.

doc_type.description: Restrict to one kind of document.

query.description: Words to find in the document text, e.g. "Metropolitan Correctional Center" or "non-prosecution agreement".

name: epstein_search_documents
title: Epstein Search Documents
